name: Extender for WooCommerce
author: Gaurav Kumar

sections.description:
Extender for WooCommerce is a WordPress WooCommerce customization plugin that covers WooCommerce customization features like change add to cart button lable, hide price if user is not logged in etc.

Extender for WooCommerce easy to set up and flexible for all customization with just simple settings. No coding required.

Detailed List of Features

  • Product Addons – Add extra items as addon to products..

  • Product Fees – Add product fees to products, add fee base on specific products, product categories.

  • Variation Swatches – Converts attribute dropdowns to attribute buttons..

Feedback

  • If you have any suggestions and feedback for plugin improvement please share..
sections.faq:
Need any coding or need a professional WordPress developer to use WC Customization Plugin?

No! You can set up everything with just activate Extender for WooCommerce without any coding skills.
